rows.text: • Polaris is raising full year 2026 guidance to adjusted EPS of $3.50 to $3.60 from $3.00 to $3.10.

The Company now expects adjusted EPS of $3.50 to $3.60 versus prior guidance of $3.00 to $3.10, of which approximately $1.09 is attributed to the benefit of tariff refunds recorded in the second and third quarters of 2026.
• Polaris is raising full year 2026 guidance to adjusted EPS of $3.00 to $3.10 from $1.60 to $1.70.

The Company now expects adjusted EPS of $3.00 to $3.10 versus prior guidance of $1.60 to $1.70, of which approximately $0.96 is attributed to the benefit of tariff refunds recorded in the second quarter of 2026.
